title: Retry with reporting that some callers want silenced
task: Write `Retry` in package `retry` that calls an operation up to a given number of attempts until it returns nil, reporting each failed attempt with the attempt number and the error. Some callers want the reports written to a log and some want nothing reported at all; do not make the silent callers pass in nothing. Test that a failing-then-succeeding operation is called the right number of times and that the silent variant works.
